name: x402-crypto-api
description: Paid crypto & Web3 security data API for AI agents. Real-time prices, market data, address analysis, token security checks, contract risk analysis, and full on-chain investigations — all accessible via x402 payment protocol (USDC on Base).

name: agent-payment-mcp
description: x402-native payment rail for AI agents. Returns 402 + accepts[], the agent presents a hard-capped Buyer Key, mints a single-use Pay Token (JWT), and passes the gateway with a Bearer. Dual rail: Stripe off-session (USD) and USDC on Base. Spend-capped, custody-free, no per-call API key.
